Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.tuner

Class TuningStore

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.tuner.TuningStore
public final class TuningStore extends Object
JSON persistence for the tuner's user-defined tunings (the built-in guitar/bass sets in Tuning.ALL are compiled in and never written here).

Custom tunings live under ~/.lg3d/tuner/ by default; override with the system property DIR_PROPERTY (tests point it at a temp folder). Every read is defensive: a missing, empty or corrupt file yields an empty list and is logged, never thrown, so a damaged config can never stop the tuner from opening. This mirrors the sibling RecorderStore pattern.

A tuning is serialised through the small TuningStore.StoredTuning DTO (a name and the string MIDI numbers) rather than Tuning itself, so none of the model's derived getters leak into the JSON and the file stays hand-editable.
